name: Palm kernel oil methyl ester
description: Palm kernel oil methyl ester (CAS 91051-32-0 ) is produced by transesterification of palm kernel oil, yielding a light, medium-chain fatty acid ester profile distinct from palm oil derivatives. It functions as a lubricant base, emulsifier, and plasticizer across personal care, cleaning, and industrial applications. In personal care formulations, it acts as an emollient carrier and skin-feel modifier. It is used in creams, lotions, and hair conditioners, where its medium-chain composition supports spreadability without heavy residue. Surfactant and detergent manufacturers use it as a feedstock or co-ingredient. It is utilized in the production of methyl ester sulfonates (MES) for household and industrial cleaning products. As a lubricant base or additive, it is applied in metalworking fluids and release agents. This material is ideal where biodegradable performance is a procurement priority. In plastics processing, it functions as a plasticizer and softener to improve flexibility and processability in polymer compounding. Palm kernel oil methyl ester is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with purity and acid value specifications varying by supplier and end-use requirement. Bulk liquid supply in ISO tanks and intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) is typical for industrial buyers.
